summary: Frozen baseline: the golden set exactly as it stood when the finder-recall experiments were run. Do not edit.

origin.snapshot: older copy of the Martian golden set, predating the introduction of the category field
origin.note: Both copies were verified to be identical before freezing.

sets.light: The 30 PRs actually measured and published (6 per repository). Defined in evals/investigation/recall-tests.js (LIGHT_CASES).

schema.prs[].caseId: key used by the eval runner
schema.prs[].originalUrl: original upstream PR/commit, when one exists
schema.prs[].sets: which sets this PR belongs to

knownGaps: No category field. Martian now classifies every golden (bug, security, concurrency, data, api, perf, test_gap, doc_defect, style, speculative) and scores by profile (strict/core/all). Their headline metric cannot be reproduced from this version.
Out of date: across the same 30 light PRs, Martian now has 120 goldens against our 95 (76 identical, 19 ours only, 44 new on their side).
Several goldens are very short one-liners (e.g. "SSRF vulnerability using open(url) without validation"), which gives the judge little to anchor on when matching a model's finding.
